requirement.original: Fix sidebar data display gaps: missing subagent TodoWrite/narration, Edit full file, AskUserQuestion answer persistence, Bash rendering consistency
requirement.clarified: Four sidebar issues analyzed: (A) subagent content missing - rendering layer is correct, root cause is upstream in reducer/data flow; (B) Edit full file is a data limitation, not fixable without CLI changes; (C) AskUserQuestion answers not persisted - answers are ephemeral in permission flow; (D) Bash rendering is already consistent between main chat and sidebar
requirement.what: Fix data gaps in sidebar agent conversation view
requirement.why: Subagent activity not fully visible to users monitoring sessions via sidebar

included: Issue A: Investigate reducer for missing subagent children data
Issue C: Add answer persistence to AskUserQuestion flow
excluded: Issue B: Edit full file display (data limitation, requires CLI changes)
Issue D: Bash rendering (already consistent, no change needed)

success_criteria: TodoWrite updates from subagents appear in sidebar conversation
Agent narration text (non-thinking) appears in sidebar conversation
AskUserQuestion answers persist across component remounts
constraints: Edit tool input only contains old_string/new_string, not full file content
AskUserQuestion answers are sent via updatedInput to Claude SDK but not persisted back

root_cause_analysis.symptom: TodoWrite and narration text from subagents not shown in sidebar; AskUserQuestion answers lost on remount
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: Issue A: SidebarAgentConversation rendering layer handles all message kinds correctly (agent-text, tool-call, agent-event, user-text). The ChildMessageBlock switch/case at line 94-122 renders TodoWrite via tool-call path and narration via agent-text path. Root cause is UPSTREAM: the reducer may not populate children[] with all subagent messages. Issue C: Answers are sent via sessionAllow RPC but neither tool.result nor tool.permission persists them back to the app. The AskUserQuestionView fallback (line 271-273) checks tool.result.answers and tool.permission.answers, but neither is ever populated.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause_commit: N/A - architectural gap, not a regression
root_cause_analysis.why_introduced: Issue A: Subagent children population was designed for tool-call messages but may not capture all message types from SDK stream. Issue C: Answer flow was designed as one-way (app -> CLI) without a persistence path back to the rendered state.
root_cause_analysis.why_problematic: Issue A: Users cannot see what subagents are doing. Issue C: Navigation away and back shows dashes instead of previously selected answers.
root_cause_analysis.timeline: Since sidebar feature was first implemented

A.title: Missing subagent data in sidebar

analysis.filterToLatestTodoWrite: Correctly keeps only last TodoWrite, filters earlier ones. NOT the problem.
analysis.agent_text_non_thinking: Rendered with sparkles icon + MarkdownView at lines 101-112. NOT the problem.
analysis.probable_root_cause: Reducer does not populate children[] for Agent tool-call messages with TodoWrite and narration text from subagent stream

A.next_step: Investigate sync/reducer.ts to verify how children[] is built for Agent/Task tool calls

B.title: Edit full file display

analysis.what_would_be_needed: CLI would need to include full file content in tool.result, significantly increasing message payload

B.recommendation: Document as known limitation. No fix planned without explicit user request for CLI-side changes.

C.title: AskUserQuestion answer persistence

answer_flow: 2. handleSubmit calls sessionAllow with responseText + answersRecord
3. CLI permissionHandler receives answers in permission response
5. Claude SDK receives answers as tool input, processes them
6. Tool result from Claude does NOT include answers
7. On remount, component checks tool.result.answers and tool.permission.answers - BOTH undefined

fix_options.description: Add answers to tool.permission in the app state when sessionAllow is called
CLI includes answers in tool result sent back to app
Store answers in MMKV keyed by permission ID

C.recommended: Option A - update the permission object in app state to include answers when sessionAllow is called, so the existing recovery code at line 271-273 works

D.title: Bash rendering consistency

analysis.inline_BashView: Truncates to 3 lines, maxHeight 80px, used in BOTH main chat and sidebar
analysis.full_BashViewFull: Full output with horizontal scrolling, used in full message detail view only
analysis.conclusion: Both locations use identical BashView component. Rendering IS consistent.

D.recommendation: No change needed. Both main chat and sidebar use the same BashView inline component.
